description: This file defines a React component for a course detail page in a learning management system. It handles course data fetching, enrollment logic, conditional rendering based on enrollment status, and integrates various context hooks and APIs for course and user progress management.

methods.name: getDefaultModules
methods.description: Generates a default list of modules for a course based on its title, primarily used as a fallback when actual modules are not available.

methods.name: CourseDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component for displaying course details, handling enrollment, and managing course viewing logic.
